CREATE TABLE "public"."company_headquarters" (
  "address" text,
  "companyId" text NOT NULL,
  "latitude" float8 NOT NULL,
  "longitude" float8 NOT NULL,
  "revision" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "updatedAt" timestamptz DEFAULT (now()) NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("companyId"),
  CONSTRAINT "company_headquarters_coordinates_3934dade" CHECK ("latitude" >= -90 AND "latitude" <= 90 AND "longitude" >= -180 AND "longitude" <= 180),
  CONSTRAINT "company_headquarters_revision_17ec8772" CHECK ("revision" > 0)
)

CREATE TABLE "public"."driver_tracking_states" (
  "accuracy" float8,
  "capturedAt" timestamptz,
  "companyId" text NOT NULL,
  "heading" float8,
  "latitude" float8,
  "longitude" float8,
  "receivedAt" timestamptz,
  "revision" int4 DEFAULT 1 NOT NULL,
  "sequence" int4 DEFAULT 0 NOT NULL,
  "sharing" bool DEFAULT false NOT NULL,
  "sharingSessionId" text NOT NULL,
  "sharingStartedAt" timestamptz NOT NULL,
  "speed" float8,
  "workerId" text NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY ("workerId"),
  CONSTRAINT "driver_tracking_coordinates_17d69af7" CHECK (("latitude" IS NULL AND "longitude" IS NULL AND "capturedAt" IS NULL AND "receivedAt" IS NULL AND "accuracy" IS NULL AND "speed" IS NULL AND "heading" IS NULL) OR ("latitude" IS NOT NULL AND "longitude" IS NOT NULL AND "capturedAt" IS NOT NULL AND "receivedAt" IS NOT NULL AND "latitude" >= -90 AND "latitude" <= 90 AND "longitude" >= -180 AND "longitude" <= 180)),
  CONSTRAINT "driver_tracking_measurements_dc4e9211" CHECK ("revision" > 0 AND "sequence" >= 0 AND ("accuracy" IS NULL OR ("accuracy" >= 0 AND "accuracy" <= 10000)) AND ("speed" IS NULL OR ("speed" >= 0 AND "speed" <= 100)) AND ("heading" IS NULL OR ("heading" >= 0 AND "heading" < 360)))
)
